name: Design database schemas and conceptual data models
description: Users requested the design of database schemas, logical data models, and Entity-Relationship structures for various specific domains, such as healthcare, logistics, and education. The tasks often involved defining entities, relationships, key attributes, and normalization, with some requests extending to generating corresponding SQL scripts, code implementations, or explaining the resulting structure.
